result.title: H3Remover: Reinforcing Video Object Removal without Paired Data
result.summary: Pretrained video editors possess rich removal and completion priors, yet may retain targets or alter unrelated content. We present H3Remover, which reinforces MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA for video object removal without paired object-free training targets. To discourage superficial edits such as recoloring, a target-removal reward favors calibrated depth changes consistent with revealing farther content. To limit unintended scene changes, a background-geometry reward encourages preservation of relative depth ordering. To preserve background appearance without retaining unwanted shadows or reflections, an appearance reward constrains RGB changes in source-derived protected regions while exempting targets and estimated effects. Frozen HPSv3 complements these constraints with perceptual-quality feedback for synthesized content. Evaluation regions remain fixed across candidates, and DiffusionART optimizes LoRA adapters with the backbone frozen. Experiments show substantial reconstruction gains over original H3, with qualitative comparisons demonstrating more effective object removal and better preservation of surrounding scene content.

AI.brief_summary: H3Remover 用多项奖励（深度变化、背景几何、外观保护与感知质量）强化预训练视频编辑模型，在无配对目标数据下实现视频物体移除，并冻结骨干仅训练 LoRA。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于视频编辑与生成任务，目标是移除物体并保持背景，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策，奖励设计也未触及 latent 内容使用或视觉旁路问题，缺少可核查的主线联系。
